SimulatedController - Class in frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers
A Controller implementation for simulation: instead of talking to real motor hardware, it drives a WPILib LinearSystemSim (an ElevatorSim, SingleJointedArmSim, DCMotorSim, FlywheelSim, or a custom subclass, supplied via ControllerConstants.simSystem) and runs its own PIDController/ ProfiledPIDController/TrapezoidProfile in software to emulate the closed-loop behavior real motor controller firmware would otherwise provide.
SimulatedController(ControllerConstants) - Constructor for class frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.SimulatedController
Builds the simulated mechanism from ControllerConstants.simSystem (detecting which LinearSystemSim subclass it is so position/velocity/current reads can be dispatched correctly), and sets up the software trapezoid profile and PID controllers used to emulate closed-loop control per ControllerConstants.real's controlConstants.

Swerve - Class in frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve
Manages a 4-module swerve drivetrain: hardware/simulation setup, acceleration- and speed-limited driving via Swerve.drive(frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveSpeeds), odometry feeding, and module/gyro access.
Swerve(SwerveConstants) - Constructor for class frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.Swerve
Builds and fully initializes the swerve drivetrain: creates the four modules and gyro (real hardware or a MapleSim simulation, depending on RobotBase.isReal()), starts the odometry thread if configured, and resets modules to their absolute encoders.

SwerveController - Class in frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve
